notes.title: Mahasona 0.6 Patch Notes
notes.content:
In this update, We have fixed some of the major bugs in the game. And we add some new things and balance the gameplay. 

[h2]What's New[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added a recovery time when Mahasona gets knocked. 
Designer Note:-
("[i]When Mahasona gets knocked he will be spawned back at his throne and was able to get back into hunting kids fast. This lead to Mahasona Winning the game for the most time since he will respawn with full health. We want to give some time for Kids to recover so we added a Respawn Timer. So When Mahasona gets knocked he will be placed in a [i]Recovery Time[/i] Until the timer end Mahasona can't move or attack.[/i]")
[/list]


[h2]Bugs Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]All the boxes in the world are now breakable. 
[*]Fix an issue with Mini Demon knocked UI.
[*]Fix an issue with Box highlight.
[*]Fix an issue with "Tharindu's" Health bar.
[*]Balanced some character's damage radius.
[/list]

-RAM Studios

notes.title: Mahasona 0.5 Patch Notes
notes.content:
In this update, we have addressed some issues and also add some quality of life changes to the game. 


[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Players can now see who knocked Mahasona on the HUD.
[*] Added an In-game voice chat activities indicate on the HUD.
[*] Players can now change the volume level of Ingame voice chat.
[*] Character Damage has been balanced.
[/list]

[h2]Updated Sound[/h2]
[list]
[*] When Crouched players will no longer make footstep sounds.
[*] Added new sounds effects for in-game activities.
[/list]


[h2]Bugs Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*]Fix an issue where players won't able to change the [i]Master Volume[/i] level.
[*]General bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]

-RAM Studios

notes.title: Mahasona 0.4 Patch Notes
notes.content:
In this update, we have addressed some issues and also add some quality of life changes to the game. 


[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Your Ping ([i]The network latency between a player's client and the game server[/i]) Now show on the HUD.
[*] HUD now shows more information about actions that players are performing in the game for example:-[i]Who placed an item in the treasure point, Who got captured by Mahasona, etc.[/i]
[*] You can now see what characters players are playing as on the HUD.
[/list]

[h2]Updated Sound[/h2]

[list]
[*] Added new voice lines for Mahasona give him more of a personality.
[*]Added some new audio cues for some actions.
[*]Improved overall sounds in the game.
[/list]

[h2]Bugs Fixes[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fix an issue where players were able to [i]crouch walks[/i] at the same speed as [i]walking[/i].
[*]Fix an issue with stairs collision that causes players to get stuck on stairs.
[*]General bug fixes and improvements.
[/list]

-RAM Studios
